name: Wright County, MO
findings: Wright County has 63 nonprofit organizations. 25 of them (40%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 18 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (45% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Wright County has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in Wright County list public events in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.4 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 17 organizations here; 44% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are public events so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?

observations.title: Social and fraternal organizations stand out for public events
observations.text: 9 social and fraternal organizations here list public events, compared with about 2 in similar places of this size.
